verdict.rationale: A community report names outlier analysis as a key Datadog advantage over open-source alternatives, and the pack lists Datadog Watchdog and Monitors docs, but only by title, with no content showing anomaly or outlier detection that works without hand-written thresholds. One critic's complaint about poor correlation is general sentiment, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: first-party documentation of anomaly/outlier monitor types or Watchdog's automatic detection, evidence that it works without manual thresholds, and hands-on corroboration of alert quality.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: Outlier analysis cited as a key advantage of Datadog and New Relic over open-source alternatives.
